title: Strong average self-concordance of the log-determinant metric at linear scale

comparators.scope: 47 explicit fixed contracts spanning actual Theorem 1.3, Gaussian laws, metric calculus, moment estimates, exact SSC threshold, minimum scale, and appendix.

comparators.rejection_detail: False premise changes the paired-trace theorem type
unauthorized_lemma_2_3_first is outside the permitted logical axioms

main_results.scope: For q > 0, s >= (q+1)/2, a positive-definite base point and arbitrary positive-semidefinite auxiliary precision, the Gaussian proposal satisfies the two-sided estimate at radius epsilon^(3/2)/sqrt(864).
One radius works uniformly over all q > 0, s >= (q+1)/2, positive-definite base points and positive-semidefinite auxiliary precisions.
For q > 0 and s > 0, SSC holds exactly when s >= (q+1)/2.
For q > 0, the least positive scale satisfying both SSC and SASC is (q+1)/2.
